info.title: MakeMyMarriage API
info.description: Proposed application API, aligned with PRD 1.1 and Database Design 1.0. No endpoints implemented. Google-only workspace auth; one wedding per account; no delete/demotion/archive operations. Google OAuth routes are owned by the selected authentication adapter and are intentionally outside this contract. Unresolved policy operations are explicitly annotated.
